sloka: द्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैव वैदेहि राघवं सह लक्ष्मणम् ।व्यवसायसमायुक्तं विष्णुं दैत्यवदे यथा ।। ५.३७.२२।।।।
transliteration: drakṣyasyadyaiva vaidehi rāghavaṁ saha lakṣmaṇam ।vyavasāyasamāyuktaṁ viṣṇuṁ daityavade yathā ।। 5.37.22।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili Just as oblations offered to the sacred fire goes to Indra, I shall offer you today to Rama waiting on the Prasravana mountain.
